name: Zetpy Product Review
author: Zetpy

sections.description:
Zetpy Product Review helps you build trust and increase conversion rates by collecting verified reviews with photos and videos. It provides a modern, user-friendly interface for your customers to share their feedback.

Key Features:

  • Verified Reviews: Ensure authenticity with verified purchase badges.
  • Media Uploads: Allow customers to upload photos and videos with their reviews.
  • Review Reminders: Automatically send email reminders to customers after purchase to request a review.
  • Review Management: Easy-to-use admin dashboard to moderate and manage reviews.
  • Featured Reviews: Highlight your best reviews to showcase customer satisfaction.
  • Modern Design: Clean and responsive layout that fits seamlessly with your theme.

Simple & Lightweight:
We focus on essential features to provide a robust review system without unnecessary bloat.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/zetpy-product-review directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Zetpy Review” menu to configure settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes, it is designed to work with most standard WooCommerce themes.

Can customers upload videos?

Yes, both photo and video uploads are supported.

Is it compatible with the latest WooCommerce?

Yes, we actively test and update for the latest WooCommerce versions.
